# Story 01 — Repo, ignore rules and branch conventions (Story: CRM-16)

## Prerequisites

- None. C
RM-16 is the first story of the `platform` feature and of the whole backlog (see `scripts/backlog.txt` line 20: `STORY 1|
repo-conventions|…|ALL:0:3|-|-`). It has no dependencies and blocks nothing directly, but every later

story is cut from the `main` branch conventions this plan defines.
- Coordinate with nobody: the repository already exists on disk with the planning system

(`.squad/`, `docs/`, `scripts/`) committed. This story **conventions** what is there; it does not re-create it.

---

## Story Goal

Turn the existing rep
o into a repo that has an obvious shape and obvious rules **before** any application code is written into it. After this story:
1. There is one git repository at the root, containing three currently-empty application roots (`api/`, `web/`,

`android/`) that are visible in a fresh clone.
2. `.gitignore` ignores **by shape** (patterns), never by hand-typ

ed filenames, so a new private note in the root never has to be added to it.
3. `README.md` at the root describes what the repository **is today
** — three empty roots plus the planning system — with **no roadmap**, **no sprint numbers**, **no mention of AI assistance**, and **no future-t

ense promises**.
4. `docs/git.md` documents the **branch model** (`main`, `sprint-N`, `<ID>-<slug>` story branches, tag per clos

ed sprint, merged branches deleted) and the **commit style** (subject = what changed; body = why and what alternative was rejected).
5. Every commit produced on the story branch re

ads as a record of decisions, not "wip".

**Not in scope:** any application code in `api/`, `web/`, `android/` (no Express, no React
, no Gradle); CI (that is `PLT-10-ALL` / CRM-28); the structure-rules script (`PLT-11-ALL` / CRM-30); D

B schema and seed (`PLT-2/6-API`); any change to the backlog system under `scripts/`.

## Product rules (from story)

**Current behaviour** (before this story)

- Repository exists with commits under `.squad/`, `docs/`, `scripts/`. `.

gitignore` exists at the root and already matches most of the acceptance list (see file inventory above).
- No `README.md` at the repository root.
- No `docs/git.md`.
- `api/`, `web/

`, `android/` exist as empty directories on disk but carry no tracked file, so a fresh `git clone` **does not create them**.

**New behaviour** (

after this story)

- **One repository, three roots.** `api/`, `web/`, `android/` are each visible in a fresh clone because each contains one

tracked placeholder file (`.gitkeep`).
- **`.gitignore` ignores by shape, never by name.** The whitelist is exactly the
acceptance list, and every rule is a pattern. A new private root-level markdown note (`ideas.md`, `todo.md`, `scratch.md`) is

ignored automatically by the `/*.md` + `!/README.md` pair — nobody edits `.gitignore` when they add a note.
- **`README.md` at the root exists and is
present-tense.** It names the three roots, describes the planning system in `.squad/`, `docs/`, and `scripts/`, and states nothing about upcoming sprints, roadmap milestones, features that do

not yet exist, or AI tooling.
- **`docs/git.md` exists** and defines:
  - Long-lived branches: `main` only.
  - Sprint branches: `spr
int-N` cut from `main`, merged back to `main` at the end of the sprint; a tag `sprint-N` (or the equivalent `block-N`, per the workspace's own vocabulary in

`docs/taxonomy.md` line 109) is placed on the merge commit.
  - Story branches: `<ID>-<slug>` (for this story: `CRM-16-repo-conventions`), cut from the

current sprint branch, merged back into it, deleted on merge.
  - Commit style: subject line is imperative present-tense, ≤ 72 ch
ars, says **what changed**. Body (blank line after subject) says **why** and **what alternative was rejected**. Wr

ap body at 72 columns.
  - **No AI attribution in any commit.** No `Co-authored-by: … noreply@anthropic.com`
, no "Generated with", no `🤖` trailer. If a commit ends up with one, it is rewritten (`git commit --amend`, `git rebase -i`) **

before** the branch is pushed for review.
- **`git log` on `CRM-16-repo-conventions`** reads as a sequence of decisions: one commit per acceptance-list item (or per

group), each with a body explaining why this shape and not another.

---

## Implementation tasks

No backend, frontend or
mobile code is added. Every change in this story is a documentation, ignore-rule, or placeholder change under the repository root and `doc

s/`.

### 1 — Verify and extend `.gitignore`

**File:** `.gitignore` (extend; do **not** rewrite)

- Line 3: `!/README.md`
- Lines 5–8:

`node_modules/`, `dist/`, `build/`, `.gradle/`

`

If — and only if — an item is missing, append it to the b
ottom of the file under a single-line comment `# CRM-16 additions`. Never re-sort the existing block; the file's

ordering carries prior decisions.

**Create file:** `README.md` (at the repository root)

## Edge Cases & Failure Modes

- **A pre
-existing commit already carries an AI trailer.** Trigger: any commit already on `main` or on a shared branch has a `Co-authored-by: …
noreply@anthropic.com` line. Expected behaviour: **out of scope** for this story to rewrite history on `main` (that would rewrite `.squad/` and `docs/` commits ever
yone shares). Record the violation in `docs/git.md` as a **known deviation** with a one-line note. The rule "no AI attribution" is enforced strictly for

commits made **from this story onward**.
- **`.gitignore` `/*.md` accidentally ignores a doc file added at the root.** Trigger: someone dr
ops `CONTRIBUTING.md` at the root. Expected behaviour: it is ignored by design. Docs live under `docs/` (
see `docs/architecture.md` and the file layout there). If a new root-level doc is genuinely wanted later, the rule is extended by ad
ding one `!/CONTRIBUTING.md` line, not by removing `/*.md`. Note this in `docs/git.md` under commit style so

the executor sees it.
- **Someone creates `README.md` inside `api/`, `web/`, or `android/`.** Trigger: reflex "every
folder needs a README". Expected behaviour: `/*.md` at line 2 only matches the **root**, so the per-root README **is tracked** — which is ex
actly what this story does **not** want. `docs/git.md` names this explicitly: the three roots carry `.gitkeep`, not `README.md`, until

`PLT-14-ALL` (hardening) decides otherwise.
- **`api/*.db` patterns exist but the `api/` directory is empty.** Trigger: the acceptance list requires the
pattern regardless. Expected behaviour: `.gitignore` lines 16–19 already carry them; keep them even though no `.db` file

exists yet, so the first API story doesn't have to add them.
- **Branch name collision with tracker id cas
ing.** Trigger: a story with a lowercase tracker id (`crm-16`). Expected behaviour: `docs/git.md` states branch names use the t
racker id **verbatim as printed by the tracker** (`CRM-16-repo-conventions`), because git branch names are case-sensitive

on Linux and case-insensitive on macOS, and mixed casing across sprints causes cross-platform breakage.
- **Merged story
branch not deleted.** Trigger: reviewer forgets `git branch -d` after merge. Expected behaviour: `docs/git.md` names this as the rule;
enforcement is by convention until `PLT-10-ALL` (CI) automates it. Note in the doc that automated pruning is out of scope for

this story.
- **A note file named `ai-notes.md` or `claude.md` at the root.** Trigger: developer takes AI-ass
isted notes locally. Expected behaviour: `/*.md` ignores it automatically — `.gitignore` does **not** name it, per the workspace-wide rule in the intake (lines 127–

131). If it ever appears in `git status` as tracked, something is wrong with the ignore rules and must be investigated before merge.
- **`docs/git.md` dis
agreeing with `docs/taxonomy.md`.** Trigger: this story uses "sprint" and the taxonomy uses "block". Expected behaviour: one paragraph in `docs/git.md` states the equivalence with a link
to `docs/taxonomy.md` line 102. `docs/verify-docs.mjs` (a future check under `PLT-12-ALL`) will ref
use a broken cross-doc link; do not cite a line number in `taxonomy.md` that

does not exist.

Not applicable to source code, but note two irreversible-ish operations:

md` under commit style.
